say:1:1322149001:1.text: It seems that everything has turned out very well.
say:1:1322149001:1.source_cn: 看来这件事有了个很不错的结果呢。

say:2:1322149002:1.text: Yes, Valka and the others can finally stop being misunderstood by the people here. While the townsfolk still need time to completely shift their thinking, it's still a positive change.
say:2:1322149002:1.source_cn: 是呀，瓦丽卡他们终于可以不用被人们误解了。虽然这里的人...
